Absolutely no cute smiling face, no baby proportions, no visible skeleton, no gore. A mysterious spectral guide from a beautiful supernatural thriller; detailed aged fabric, fine fraying, cinematic shadow gradients. Front three-quarter view, entire floating silhouette visible.
